description: Live OpenRouter CLI smoke test with a locally injected stall after the first nonempty text delta.

result.exactOutputCheck: SHA-256 of the CLI subprocess stdout bytes matched SHA-256 of the UTF-8 bytes of the first provider text delta. Each was one byte.
result.idleDiagnostic: Stream idle for 1000 ms after receiving text

windowsPreload.fix: Pass a file:// URL to Node's --import flag for the ESM preload instead of an absolute Windows drive-letter path.

scope: One successful request to the listed model on Windows. The stall was injected locally. The receipt omits credentials, prompts, raw output, and the digest of the short output.
